description: The Ministry of Health requires a structured list of health facilities in Kenema district for a WHO harmonization exercise. Using the DHIS2 Maintenance app at http://localhost:8080 (login: admin / district): (1) Create a new SQL View named 'Kenema District Facility List'. (2) Write a SQL query to select the name, code, and shortname of all organisation units that are sub-units of Kenema district. Note: The main table is 'organisationunit' and Kenema is a parent organisation unit. (3) Save the SQL View as type 'Query'. (4) Execute the view to verify it returns data. (5) Download the results (CSV or Excel) to /home/ga/Downloads/.
